about.pageSubtitle: Over a decade of expertise in carbon graphite seal manufacturing — quality you can trust.
about.companyPara1: Huahao Sealing Co., Ltd. is located in Huoqiu County, Lu'an City, Anhui Province. Founded in 2019, formerly Zhejiang Jiashan Xianfeng Carbon. A professional manufacturer of graphite seals and graphite bushings.
about.companyPara2: Leveraging local resource advantages, we provide high-performance, high-reliability sealing and wear-resistant solutions for industrial equipment worldwide. With mature production processes and a complete quality control system, our products feature self-lubrication, high temperature resistance, corrosion resistance, and cost-effectiveness, widely used in pumps, valves, compressors, reactors, chemical metallurgy, and mechanical seals.
about.companyPara3: We offer custom machining per drawings or samples to meet diverse operating conditions. Free sample testing is supported — let customers verify quality before bulk orders. Huahao Sealing always prioritizes quality for survival and reputation for development, looking forward to global cooperation!
